title: Hubei Xingfa Chemicals Group Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Materials Manufacturer
content:
Hubei Xingfa Chemicals Group Co., Ltd. is a large listed Chinese chemicals manufacturer with extensive phosphorus-based and new-materials operations. Public aerogel-industry reporting states that the group has developed silica-aerogel powder processes and launched aerogel blanket and insulation-sheet production lines as part of its materials expansion.

Company Overview

The official English-language corporate site confirms Xingfa as a major industrial manufacturing group with broad new-material and chemical capabilities. Public industry-source reporting further describes dedicated aerogel process development and product commercialization tied to the group’s silica-based materials work.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with large-scale industrial manufacturing and wider commercial reach.
  • Focus Areas: New materials, silica-based product development, industrial insulation, and battery-oriented thermal-protection materials.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Public Aerogel Product Reference: Industry-source reporting describes silica aerogel powder, aerogel blankets, and aerogel insulation sheets.
  • Public Capacity Reference: Industry-source reporting states that a subsidiary production line entered operation in 2024 with 2,500 m³/year aerogel blankets and 2,500 m³/year aerogel insulation sheets; this figure is not clearly stated on the reviewed official English corporate pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Presence: China-based group manufacturing operations as presented on the official corporate site.
  • International Certifications: The reviewed official pages do not clearly list aerogel-specific international certification details.
  • Official Website: http://en.xingfagroup.com/

FAQ

Why is Hubei Xingfa included in the aerogel directory?

The official corporate site confirms Xingfa’s large-scale new-materials and industrial-manufacturing business, while public aerogel-industry reporting describes dedicated aerogel process and product development linked to the group.

What aerogel-related products are publicly associated with Xingfa?

Public industry-source materials describe silica aerogel powder, aerogel blankets, and aerogel insulation sheets.

Are the aerogel production figures official-site figures?

The reviewed official corporate pages confirm the broader company profile, but the specific aerogel production figures come from public industry-source reporting rather than the reviewed official English pages.
